answer: A haven, a public registry that merges agents linked by funding paths, keys or shared hosts, prices every voyage, an agent identity, by its rank in its cluster: the k-th voyage must lock 2^(k-1) × 100 yarrow, a staked token, for as long as it acts. If the haven later merges clusters, bonds are repriced and any shortfall is slashed. One honest voyage locks 100 yarrow; 20 clones funded from one wallet lock about 105 million. It breaks if the haven cannot trace funds laundered through mixers or unrelated buyers.
